name: Confirmation Cancellation Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why a confirmation is cancelled.

CSHN.name: Cash Not Received
CSHN.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the cash has not been received.

REPL.name: Confirmation Replacement
REPL.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because it will be replaced.

BENA.name: Incorrect Back End Load Amount
BENA.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the back end load amount is incorrect.

CSHW.name: Incorrect Cash Amount
CSHW.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the cash amount is incorrect.

DISA.name: Incorrect Discount Amount
DISA.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the discount amount is incorrect.

DISC.name: Incorrect Discount Amount Currency
DISC.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the discount amount has an incorrect currency.

EXCH.name: Incorrect Exchange Rate
EXCH.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the exchange rate is incorrect.

FEEE.name: Incorrect Fee Or Commission
FEEE.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because a fee or commission amount is incorrect.

DQUA.name: Incorrect Financial Instrument Quantity
DQUA.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the financial instrument quantity is incorrect.

FENA.name: Incorrect Front End Load Amount
FENA.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the front end load amount is incorrect.

GROA.name: Incorrect Gross Amount
GROA.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the gross amount is incorrect.

GROC.name: Incorrect Gross Amount Currency
GROC.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the gross amount has an incorrect currency.

NETA.name: Incorrect Net Amount
NETA.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the net amount is incorrect.

NETC.name: Incorrect Net Amount Currency
NETC.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the net amount has an incorrect currency.

OPER.name: Incorrect Operation
OPER.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because of an incorrect operation.

MINI.name: Incorrect Quantity Units Or Cash
MINI.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because of an incorrect minimum traded quantity or cash amount.

DMON.name: Incorrect Settlement Amount
DMON.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the settlement amount is incorrect.

NCRR.name: Incorrect Settlement Amount Currency
NCRR.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the settlement amount has an incorrect currency.

DDAT.name: Incorrect Settlement Date
DDAT.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the settlement date is incorrect.

SETS.name: Incorrect Settlement Method
SETS.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the settlement method is incorrect.

DDEA.name: Incorrect Trade Date
DDEA.definition: Confirmation is cancelled because the trade date is incorrect.

REFE.name: Invalid Reference
REFE.definition: Confirmation contains an invalid business reference.
